question: Does the reported importance of rating_accuracy_score track Shopping_Satisfaction beyond the selection-adjusted no-effect null?
action: treat rating accuracy as a candidate satisfaction driver and re-check it in a held-out model before the storefront acts on it

evidence.baseline: no-effect permutation of Shopping_Satisfaction over the whole 12-feature family (max |rho| at this n)
evidence.falsifier: the interval's lower bound falls at or below the selection-adjusted null 0.117 — the feature would then be indistinguishable from a Shopping_Satisfaction shuffle over the same family

provenance.selection: family of 12 EDA-ranked features declared in amazon_survey.yaml; the null takes their max |rho|
provenance.exclusions: none beyond the pairwise-complete pair and the ETL contract
